environment: Existing Chrome session through computer-use; desktop viewport and 390x844 responsive override. No CPU/network throttling; not a physical phone.

tests.observed: Dawn preview: brand logo, eight products, six departments; preview bar Draft/password protected.
Visible search for collar returned one product at USD24.
Availability exposed 7 in stock / 1 out of stock. Out-of-stock selection returned dispenser, 1 of8. Visible Reset restored8.
Plateado selected through visible pill; variant URL changed and cart line showed Plateado.
Existing organizer1 USD18 plus collar Plateado1 USD24 =USD42. Collar quantity2 yielded USD66. Collar removed.
Organizer(local2–3days)+bag(external10–15days)=USD40; mixed delivery notice visible. Removing bag restored organizer1/USD18 and removed notice.
390x844 home screenshot; no horizontal overflow at home: innerWidth390/documentWidth375. Menu opened six departments; Mascotas navigated correctly.
Dispenser displayed Sold out/Out of stock and disabled purchase buttons.

issues.finding: Native search/cart/filter/availability controls and mixed-delivery notice render in English while demo content is Spanish.
issues.recommendation: Complete Spanish locale setup and verify all native/custom messages.

issues.finding: Mobile search button and introductory block occupy much of initial viewport; departments begin near bottom.
issues.recommendation: Reduce intro/search vertical space while preserving tap areas and readable text.

issues.finding: Product title demo prefix wraps to multiple lines on product page.
issues.recommendation: Keep clear demo identification; consider a separate visible demo badge and shorter title in a later design iteration.

issues.finding: Sold-out dispenser still shows a delivery window, alongside Out of stock.
issues.recommendation: Clarify/suppress delivery estimate for unavailable products.

issues.finding: Buy it now and account affordances remain visible in a demo with no checkout validation.
issues.recommendation: Review whether to hide accelerated purchase/account entry for the visual review.
